svg.aria-label: squid-protocol/gitgalaxy: promoter-bot fleet: the limit in force each day and hour, and bots allowed against bots working

g.text: squid-protocol/gitgalaxy: promoter-bot fleet: what limits the fleet
Nov 8, the last finished day: the main limit was Code generation at max, 13.6 h per host.

g.title: Each minute gets the first thing that, if removed, would start another bot. It only sees launches: with every slot full it says code generation, even if merges are stuck behind CI

g.text: Limits: each minute gets the first thing that, if removed, would start another bot. Launches only: a full fleet shows code generation at max, whatever waits downstream.
Days are UTC; faded marks are today so far. The agy lane isn't counted in bots working; bots allowed is one reading a day.
